result: {"ratings": {"Maya": {"rating": 5, "familiarity": "somewhat", "why": "She sketched the fish quickly, took on the joins at the tail, and when I wrongly flagged a jammed domino she checked it and told the table plainly it was fine, which kept the tail from being disturbed."}, "Tom": {"rating": 5, "familiarity": "closely", "why": "He laid the start and the whole top line, did the top join himself, and found and bridged the wide gap at the bottom of the tail, reporting each step clearly."}, "Priya": {"rating": 4, "familiarity": "somewhat", "why": "She laid the bottom line cleanly, told us when it was ready for the join, and held off clearing the strays until they were checked, but her part was smaller than Tom's or Maya's."}}}
